finding: The CPython 3.14 library index lists only wave and colorsys under Multimedia Services. wave reads WAV only; io and struct return or unpack caller-chosen bytes without recognising MPEG frame sync, Layer III headers, bitrate or sample-rate tables. No standard-library MP3 parser or decoder is documented.
limit: Scoped to the official CPython 3.14 documentation index, checked 2026-11-17. It matches the CPython 3.13 finding in data/python/mp3_id3v2/standard.json; aifc and sunau were removed in 3.13 and never handled MP3.
